title: Lamuni, tanadi, turawa: nemo farashin gaskiya da haɗari
course_title: Mahimman Fintech: Yadda Kuɗin Dijital ke Aiki a Afirka

say: Lamuni, ajiyar kuɗi da aika kuɗi: nemo farashin gaskiya, da haɗari.
Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar biyu na Fintech Fundamentals.
Lamunin dijital na iya barin ɗan kasuwa ya sake dawo da shi a yau maimakon wata mai zuwa. Amma wasu aikace-aikacen sun caje kuɗaɗe masu yawa da kuma tursasa masu bashi.

say: Ka'idodin lamuni galibi suna nuna kuɗi ko jimlar don biya, ba ƙididdigewa ba. Don kwatanta gaskiya, juya kowane lamuni zuwa ƙimar lokaci guda. Misali, Bisi a Ibadan na bukatar Naira 50,000 a hannun jari.

card.title: Bisi ya kwatanta tayin lamuni guda biyu
card.note: Juya kowane lamuni zuwa ƙimar kowane wata tukuna.

say: App A ya ce ya biya Naira 57,500 a cikin kwanaki 30. Kudin ya kai Naira 7,500, wato kashi 15% a wata, wato kusan kashi 182.5% a shekara.

say: FCCPC tana kula da masu ba da lamuni na dijital kuma tana buga jerin waɗanda aka yarda. Mai ba da lamuni da ke da alhakin nuna cikakken farashi kafin karɓa, kuma ya fara kaɗan.

panel.heading: Mai ba da lamuni mai alhaki ko ƙa'idar yaudara?
left: An nuna cikakken farashi kafin karɓa
Akan FCCPC da aka amince da lissafin

right: Yana son lambobin sadarwarku ko hotuna

say: Jajayen tutoci: ƙa'idar da ke buƙatar lambobin sadarwarku ko hotunanku, suna barazanar aika sako ga danginku, waɗanda masu gudanarwa suka hana, ɓoye jimlar, ko tura sabon lamuni don biya tsohon.

say: Kafin kayi ajiya a cikin app, san abin da ka mallaka. Babban bankin CBN ne ke tsara ajiyar ajiyar banki kuma hukumar NDIC ta ba da inshora har zuwa iyaka. Nemo iyaka na yanzu akan gidan yanar gizon NDIC.

panel.heading: Abubuwa guda uku masu kama

cards.d: CBN ne ya tsara. NDIC inshorar ajiya har zuwa iyaka. Duba iyakar halin yanzu da kanka.
Da'awar akan iyo da aka gudanar a bankuna. An kiyaye shi ta dokokin kiyaye ruwa.
Misali asusun kasuwar kudi. SEC Najeriya ta tsara. Darajarsa na iya hawa sama ko ƙasa.

say: Ma'auni na walat shine da'awar akan iyo wanda dole ne a riƙe a bankuna.

say: Don tunawa. Kwatanta lamuni ta kowane wata. Bincika cewa mai ba da bashi yana cikin jerin FCCPC. Sanin ko ajiyar ku ajiya ne, walat ko saka hannun jari. Ƙara kuɗin da gefen musayar tare. Kuma kar a taɓa raba PIN ko OTP ɗin ku.

items: Kwatanta lamuni ta kowane wata
Duba jerin masu ba da lamuni da FCCPC ta amince
Deposit, walat ko zuba jari?
Kudin aikawa = fee + FX gefe

say: Yanzu duba tayin lamuni na gaske ba tare da karɓe shi ba, kwatanta ƙimar kuɗi guda biyu, da ƙa'idar da ba ta tabbatar da zamba ɗaya da kuke amfani da ita ba, sannan ku gargaɗi danginku game da zamba na OTP.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
